market_summary: US markets are being driven by major infrastructure and tech deals: Amazon signed a 20-year power purchase agreement with Constellation Energy to add 190 MW of capacity at Calvert Cliffs nuclear plant with USD3 billion in planned investment, lifting CEG stock 3.9%. Meta faces IRS challenges to $355M in research tax credits tied to Mark Zuckerberg's stock options, though the company's overall research credits jumped from $700M in 2023 to $3.9B in 2025. Apple was notably absent from Trump's White House AI summit on Sept 29 where other tech megacaps signed an AI safety accord. In Asia, Singapore Airlines and Scoot extended Middle East flight cancellations to December due to geopolitical tensions. Regional banks and infrastructure firms are navigating complex market conditions with management changes at DBS and ongoing operations challenges.

items.headline: Amazon Signs 20-Year Nuclear Power Deal with Constellation Energy for $3 Billion Investment
items.summary: Amazon agreed to purchase 690 megawatts of power from Constellation Energy's Calvert Cliffs nuclear plant in Maryland over 20 years, enabling over $3 billion in infrastructure investment to add 190 MW of new capacity between 2030-2032, supporting the company's AI data center expansion.

items.headline: Meta Faces IRS Challenge Over $355 Million Zuckerberg Tax Break
items.summary: The IRS is seeking to recover $355 million in research tax credits Meta claimed on Mark Zuckerberg's $4.1 billion stock option compensation in 2012-2013, with Meta and the IRS disagreeing on whether his stock gains qualify as research wages.

items.headline: Meta's Research Tax Credits Soared from $700M to $3.9B as AI Data Centers Classified as Experiments
items.summary: Meta's research tax credits increased dramatically from $700 million in 2023 to $3.9 billion in 2025, with the company classifying its AI data centers as experimental 'pilot models' for tax purposes, raising scrutiny from tax authorities.

items.headline: Blackstone Singapore Chairman Gautam Banerjee Joins DBS Group Board
items.summary: DBS Group appointed Gautam Banerjee, chairman and senior managing director of Blackstone Singapore, to the boards of DBS Group Holdings and DBS Bank effective October 1, 2026, bringing extensive governance and strategic leadership experience.

items.headline: Singapore Airlines and Scoot Extend Middle East Flight Cancellations to December
items.summary: Singapore Airlines extended cancellation of Dubai flights to December 2, while Scoot extended cancellation of Jeddah flights to the same date, citing ongoing geopolitical tensions in the Middle East affecting regional aviation operations.

items.headline: Apple Conspicuously Absent from Trump's White House AI Summit
items.summary: Apple was notably excluded from Trump's White House artificial intelligence meeting on September 29 where other tech megacaps including Nvidia, Meta, Google, Microsoft, and OpenAI executives signed an AI safety accord, with neither Tim Cook nor new CEO John Ternus attending.
